scope: Proposition 7.8 (Passive micro replacement) of the manuscript “Quasipolynomial Bounds for Arithmetic Progressions” (preprints/Quasipolynomial-Bounds-for-Arithmetic-Progressions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 159 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 481eaf7730dc4d58), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose j > s and the ascent format holds on a warm-inverse fraction of paths at a fixed parent and feasible center. Use the group and the two fields of Lemma 7.5. There is a single ambient ordinary filtered polynomial gU (u) ∈ G0 of degree at most s, with no β argument, for which a warm-inverse fraction of the productive paths have warm-cost subslices on which replacing gψ by gU ◦ ψ preserves a positive signed full-mass score of warm size, after the allowed small target discounts. Both inherited cutoff functions and all their exact determining conditions are retained.
